learning.learning_goal: Hear, see, and connect each number from 0 through 10 to a group of objects.
learning.big_idea: A number can name how many objects are in a group.
novice_success_criteria: say or identify the number words from zero through ten
connect each numeral from 0 through 10 to its spoken name and quantity
count a group to ten by counting each object once, even when the objects move
make a requested group of dots without choosing from answer options

screens.label: Start here
screens.title: Meet the numbers 0 through 10.
screens.body: Tap the dots. Listen to each number.
screens.audio: We will learn the numbers zero through ten. You will see each number, hear its name, and count that many dots.

screens.label: Number 0
screens.title: 0 — zero
screens.audio: This is zero. The box has no dots. Zero means none. Look inside the box.

visual.ariaLabel: An empty box with no dots. Zero dots.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Look in the empty box. How many dots are inside? Choose a number.

visual.ariaLabel: An empty box. There are no dots inside.

choices.feedback: One would mean a dot is inside. Look in the box again.
The box has no dots. That is zero.
Two would mean two dots are inside. Look in the box again.

hints: Look inside the box. Do you see any dots?
No dots means zero dots.

screens.label: Number 1
screens.title: 1 — one
screens.audio: This is one. One dot. Tap the dot to hear one.

visual.ariaLabel: One blue dot labeled 1.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: One blue dot inside one box.

choices.feedback: Zero means there are no dots. This box has one dot.
There is one dot.
Two means there would be two dots. Count this dot once.

hints: Look inside the box. Point to the dot once.
One dot matches the number 1.

screens.label: Number 2
screens.title: 2 — two
screens.audio: This is two. Two dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two.

visual.ariaLabel: Two blue dots labeled 1 and 2.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Two blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look at both dots. Count each one once.
Three means there would be one more dot. Count again.
There are two dots.

hints: Start with the dot on the left. Then count the dot on the right.
Count again: one, two.

screens.label: Number 3
screens.title: 3 — three
screens.audio: This is three. Three dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots labeled 1, 2, and 3.

screens.title: Count the dots.
screens.audio: Count the blue dots. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots in a row.

choices.feedback: Look at the dot on the right, too.
There are three dots.
Check that you did not count a dot twice.

hints: Start with the dot on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three.

screens.label: New word
screens.title: This is a group.
screens.audio: These three dots are together inside one box. Dots together are called a group. This is one group of three dots.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots together inside one box.
visual.message: Dots together in one box are a group.

screens.label: Number 4
screens.title: 4 — four
screens.audio: This is four. Four dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three, four.

visual.ariaLabel: Four blue dots labeled 1 through 4.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Four blue dots together in one box.

choices.feedback: Look at every dot, including the one on the right.
There are four dots in this group.
Count each dot once. Check that none was counted twice.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make four dots.
screens.audio: Here is a group of four dots. To make your own, start with an empty box. Add dots, one at a time. Stop when you have four.

visual.ariaLabel: A box containing four dots.

screens.label: Your turn
screens.title: Make 4 dots.
screens.audio: Start with an empty box. Tap Add a dot until you have four dots. You can remove a dot. Then tap Check my dots.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count the dots in your box. Add or remove a dot, then check again.
hints: Tap Add a dot to put a dot in the box.
Point to each dot and count: one, two, three, four. Stop at four.

screens.label: Number 5
screens.title: 5 — five
screens.audio: This is five. Five dots. Tap the dots in order: one, two, three, four, five.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots labeled 1 through 5.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look at the dot on the right. Count it too.
Check that you counted each dot only once.
There are five dots in this group.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four, five.

screens.label: Number 6
screens.title: 6 — six
screens.audio: This is six. Six dots. Tap the dots in order from one through six.

visual.ariaLabel: Six blue dots labeled 1 through 6.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Six blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
There are six dots.
Check that you did not count one dot twice.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again: one, two, three, four, five, six.

screens.label: Number 7
screens.title: 7 — seven
screens.audio: This is seven. Seven dots. Tap the dots in order from one through seven.

visual.ariaLabel: Seven blue dots labeled 1 through 7.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Seven blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Check that you did not count one dot twice.
Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
There are seven dots.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again from one through seven.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make 7 dots.
screens.audio: Make a new group of seven dots. Tap Add a dot to put dots in the box. Check your group when you are ready.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count the dots in your box. Add or remove a dot, then check again.
hints: Point to every dot once. Say its number as you point.
Keep adding or removing until your count ends at seven.

visual.ariaLabel: Eight blue dots labeled 1 through 8.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Eight blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
There are eight dots.
Check that you did not count one dot twice.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again from one through eight.

screens.label: Number 9
screens.title: 9 — nine
screens.audio: This is nine. Nine dots. Tap the dots in order from one through nine.

visual.ariaLabel: Nine blue dots labeled 1 through 9.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Nine blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Check that you did not count one dot twice.
Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
There are nine dots.

Count again from one through nine.

screens.label: Number 10
screens.title: 10 — ten
screens.audio: This is ten. Ten dots. Tap the dots in order from one through ten.

visual.ariaLabel: Ten blue dots labeled 1 through 10.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Choose the matching number.

visual.ariaLabel: Ten blue dots inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look for a dot you may have missed. Count each dot once.
There are ten dots.
Count each dot once. Check for two dots you may have missed.

hints: Start on the left. Point to each dot once.
Count again from one through ten.

screens.title: The total is the whole group.
screens.body: The last number is the total. Total means the number of dots in the group.
screens.audio: Count each dot once. The last number is the total. Total means the number of dots in the whole group.

screens.label: New shape
screens.title: Dots can move.
screens.audio: These five dots are spread out. The spaces do not change how many there are. Count each dot once.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots spread out, labeled one through five.

screens.title: Count the spread-out dots.
screens.audio: The dots are spread out. Count each one once. Choose how many dots there are.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots spread out inside one box.

choices.feedback: Look for a dot you missed. Count each one once.
Check that you did not count one dot twice.
There are five dots. Moving them apart did not add any.

hints: Start at the left and point to each dot once.
Say one, two, three, four, five as you point.

screens.title: Count this group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in the box. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Ten blue dots spread out inside one box.

choices.feedback: You may have missed a dot. Start on the left and count again.
There are ten dots in this group.
You may have counted a dot twice.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count slowly from one through ten.

screens.title: What is the total?
screens.prompt: You count four dots. What is the total?
screens.audio: You count four dots. What is the total? Choose an answer.

choices.feedback: Yes. The total is four dots.

hints: Total means the number of dots in the whole group.
The group has four dots.

screens.title: Count a new group.
screens.audio: Count the dots in this new group. Choose the number that matches the group.

visual.ariaLabel: Six blue dots spread out inside one box.

choices.feedback: Check that you counted each dot only once.
Look for a dot you may have missed.
There are six dots in this group.

hints: Start on the left. Count each dot once.
Count again from one through six.

screens.title: What is a group?
screens.prompt: The dots are together inside one box. What do we call them?
screens.audio: The dots are together inside one box. What do we call them? Choose an answer.
hints: Think about all the dots together.
Dots together are called a group.

screens.title: You met the numbers 0 through 10.
screens.body: Practice counting in other shapes before moving to pairing.
screens.audio: You finished. You saw and heard zero through ten. Practice counting groups in different shapes before moving to pairing.
screens.nextRecommendation: Keep practicing this category. Pairing comes after its remaining skills.
